events.title: Demo Update: Energy Core Dismantling and Merchant Exchange Fixes
events.summary: This Demo update fixes two issues affecting building changes and merchant exchanges. Energy Core and foundation dismantling Fixed an issue that could prevent walls near the Energy Core from being dismantled. The foundation supporting the Energy Core can now be dismantled. The core moves to a nearby available foundation only after its own supporting foundation is removed. Dismantling nearby walls or other foundations does not trigger a move. events.title: Moving Castle Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: Make your home in a walking castle, and set off on a journey with your residents. The Moving Castle demo is now available to download for free on Steam. Build your own mobile home, organize your residents’ work and daily lives, explore and gather resources on your travels, and face battles together. The game has just one developer and is still rough around the edges, but I’m continuing to improve it. events.title: The Playtest Is Live! Thank You for Joining!
events.summary: Hello everyone! I’m excited to announce that the MovingCastle Playtest is now live! A huge thank you to everyone taking the time to help test the game! I’m so happy to finally share it with you, and I can’t wait to hear what you think. Every bug report, suggestion, and honest impression helps me make the game better.
